node_definition.done_when: Done when a new tests/test_a_promotion_reads_only_its_own_rollout_home.py builds a temporary crew home with 200 run directories, each carrying a harness sessions root, and with the promoting run's rollout under its own home. Every environment-resolved directory points at a temporary path: the crew home, and the client sessions root rollout.CLIENT_SESSIONS_DIR , a module constant bound at import, which the test patches. The test counts the directories _harvest_lane_receipt stats, and asserts the count does not grow with the number of other runs: with 200 and with 20 other runs it is the same. It also asserts the receipt read is the promoting run's own. The negative control drops the run_id argument, which makes the stat count grow with the run population. The base, head and negative-control logs are written under the run directory, each starting with its revision and literal command and ending in EXIT= . The node's evidence fragment is docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-answers-inside-its-deadline/a-promotion-reads-only-its-own-rollout-home.html . The test files importing reckon.crew.promotion_release or reckon.crew.rollout add no failure against the base revision, run one arm at a time with at most -n 4 . Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. Write paths: reckon/crew/promotion_release.py , the new test and the evidence fragment.
